The Second Garden was not prepared land; Adam’s people lived primitively and labored with the sweat of their brows [76:1.4].
24.036.h4: 2) The Tragedy of Cain and Abel
24.037.p: Before the establishment of the new Garden, Cain, born of Cano and Eve, entered the world, and Sansara, the child of Laotta and Adam, was born but raised by Eve because Laotta died in childbirth [76:0.2]. In the Second Garden, Abel became a shepherd and Cain a farmer [76:2.1].
24.038.p: Abel mocked Cain’s Nodite lineage, and Cain’s natural combativeness led to a moment of rage in which he killed Abel [76:2.4]–2.5.
24.039.p: Cain later repented sincerely, received an indwelling Thought Adjuster [76:2.8], and became a significant peacemaker between the Nodites and the Adamites [76:2.9].
24.040.h4: 3) The Mission of the Sethites and the Rise of the Andites
24.041.p: Seth, firstborn of Adam and Eve in the Second Garden, became the head of a new priestly order [76:3.4]. The Sethite priests developed a threefold ministry in religion, health, and education, contributing extensively to surrounding tribes [76:3.5]–3.9.
24.042.p: After their demotion to mortal status, Adam resolved to leave as much of his life plasm as possible for the world [76:4.8]. Under Eve’s direction, 1,682 selected women received Adam’s life plasm [76:4.8]. Their children became the earliest ancestors of the great Andite peoples [76:4.8].
24.043.h4: 4) The Final Destiny of Adam and Eve
24.044.p: Eve died first of heart failure nineteen years before Adam [76:5.5]. Adam lived to the age of 530 and died naturally of old age [76:5.5]. After their demotion, they both received Thought Adjusters [76:5.2], and they fully understood that their Paradise ascent remained open to them [76:5.2].
24.045.p: On the third day after Adam’s death, according to the mandate of Edentia and Salvington, Adam and Eve were re-personalized in the resurrection halls of the Mansonia worlds along with 1,316 loyal comrades from the First Garden [76:6.2]. They progressed rapidly through the mansion worlds, attained Jerusem citizenship [76:6.3], and were later appointed among the twenty-four planetary counselors now administering Urantia [76:6.3].
24.046.p: Thus ended the earthly story of a Material Son and Daughter who erred, endured tragedy, and ultimately achieved personal spiritual triumph [76:6.4].
25.title: The Five Epochal Revelations of Urantia
25.001.p: The history of Urantia is marked by five major dispensational revelations. Each age represents a purposeful spiritual intervention designed to elevate humankind’s intellectual, moral, and spiritual progress under the Universal Father’s plan. These five revelations form a continuous ascending staircase of truth, each one illuminating the next and guiding humanity from primitive consciousness toward the ultimate age of Light and Life.
25.002.h3: 1. First Dispensational Age: The Advent of the Planetary Prince
25.004.p: The first dispensational age was the earliest epochal revelation brought to Urantia. During this period, the Planetary Prince and his staff initiated the first organized effort to uplift human civilization and reveal basic spiritual truth. This age represents humanity’s first systematic contact with higher planetary administration.
25.006.p: The central figures were Caligastia, the Planetary Prince, and his one hundred corporeal staff members. At the beginning of his mission, Caligastia possessed admirable preparation, tested leadership, and promising qualifications. His staff represented the finest materialized assistants drawn from the system administration [66:1.4].
25.008.p: The Prince’s headquarters, Dalamatia, became the first center of culture, learning, and social organization. From here, the first clear concept of the First Source and Center—the Universal Father—was proclaimed on Urantia. The staff instructed early humans in agriculture, social order, moral conduct, and spiritual worship [66:2.8].
25.010.p: This age was suddenly disrupted when Caligastia joined the Lucifer Rebellion. The planetary administration collapsed, the Prince’s staff was lost or corrupted, and Urantia entered a long period of spiritual isolation. Much of the early teaching was distorted or forgotten, leaving humanity without planetary guidance for thousands of years [66:4.7].
25.011.h3: 2. Second Dispensational Age: The Arrival of Adam and Eve
25.013.p: The second dispensational revelation was inaugurated by the arrival of Adam and Eve, the Material Son and Daughter sent from Jerusem. Their mission was biological uplifting and spiritual renewal after the ruin caused by the Planetary Prince’s betrayal.
25.015.p: Adam and Eve were sent to:
25.016.p: restore the concept of the Universal Father among the evolutionary races, and introduce superior life plasm to biologically enhance humankind.
25.017.p: They lived in the Garden of Eden, the actual origin of the legends of paradise, creation, and the first humans. Their presence signified a new attempt to unify and uplift the divided and deteriorating races of the world.
25.019.p: The Garden of Eden was a prepared environment where Adam and Eve maintained prolonged vitality through access to the Tree of Life. Many later religious symbols—paradise, the tree of life, the forbidden fruit, the fall of man—originated as distorted memories of this era.
25.021.p: Adam and Eve departed prematurely from the established plan due to impatience and well-intentioned but misguided haste. As a result, they lost their immortal status and were reduced to mortal life. Yet their partial contribution and the violet race they originated provided significant biological and cultural improvement for later civilizations.
25.022.h3: 3. Third Dispensational Age: The Incarnation of Melchizedek
25.024.p: The third dispensational revelation began when Machiventa Melchizedek, an Emergency Son of Nebadon, incarnated in the region of Salem at a time when truth had almost disappeared from the earth.
25.026.p: Melchizedek appeared as the “King of Salem” and “Priest of the Most High God.” His message was simple and universal: salvation comes through personal faith and trust in God. He taught that God is the Most High, the Father of all, and receives each person who comes to Him by sincere faith.
25.028.p: Melchizedek formed a covenant with Abraham and spread the seeds of monotheism among many tribes. His teachings survived in various religious traditions, often in fragmentary or symbolic forms. The Salem gospel became the bridge that prepared the world for the fourth epochal revelation—the life and teachings of Jesus.
25.030.p: After ninety-four years of effective ministry, Melchizedek withdrew. Yet his spiritual legacy lived on for millennia, shaping the foundations of later faiths and opening the way for the coming of the Creator Son.
25.031.h3: 4. Fourth Dispensational Age: The Life and Teachings of Jesus
25.033.p: The fourth dispensational revelation is the incarnation of Michael of Nebadon as the human Jesus of Nazareth. This event is the most complete revelation of God that Urantia has ever received and holds cosmic significance throughout the local universe.
25.035.p: Jesus revealed God not only as Creator and Sovereign of the universe but as a loving personal Father. His life demonstrated the divine way of living, centered on love, mercy, service, and brotherhood. His personality was marked by perfect balance, harmony, and unity rather than mere perfection of isolated traits.
25.037.p: When a Creator Son bestows himself upon a world, he ends that dispensation and judges the domain. After completing his mission, Jesus released the Spirit of Truth upon all flesh, enabling believers to experience inner guidance. From this time onward, those who choose faith can pass directly to the mansion worlds after death.
25.039.p: Jesus’ bestowal did not simply close an age; it opened the eternal path of spiritual ascent for every mortal. His revelation continues to shape the conscience and spiritual experience of humanity across all succeeding generations.
25.040.h3: 5. Fifth Dispensational Age: The Urantia Papers Revelation
25.042.p: The fifth dispensational revelation is the presentation of The Urantia Book. It openly states that it represents the fifth epochal revelation given to humankind. Unlike previous revelations delivered by a single being, this one is a coordinated effort of many supermortal personalities.
25.043.h4: 2) Nature and Purpose of the Revelation
25.044.p: This revelation adapts cosmic truth to the intellectual and cultural conditions of time and space. Its purpose is to expand cosmic consciousness, deepen spiritual understanding, and unify scientific, philosophical, and religious insight. It aims to harmonize reason with living faith.
25.046.p: The papers emphasize that no revelation before reaching the eternal goal can be complete or final. This fifth revelation prepares humanity to receive future truth by elevating thought, refining spiritual perception, and illuminating the universe context of human existence.
25.048.p: This age invites humanity to rediscover Jesus’ original gospel beyond distorted traditions, encourages personal fellowship with the indwelling Spirit, and calls individuals to choose their eternal destiny freely. The Urantia revelation provides a new lens for understanding life, service, and the ascending career.
25.049.p: Closing Analogy: The Five Ages as Beacons of Progress
25.050.p: The five dispensational revelations function as ascending beacons of cosmic light. Each age dispels the shadows of the previous one and guides humanity toward higher truth. Together they form a divine sequence, leading mortals from evolutionary beginnings toward spiritual maturity and the dawn of Light and Life.
